description: Unique alphanumeric customer identifier (Primary Key, format NNNN-LLLLL)
Customer gender ('Female', 'Male')
Binary indicator whether customer is 65 or older (0 = No, 1 = Yes)
Whether the customer has a spouse/partner ('Yes', 'No')
Whether the customer has dependents ('Yes', 'No')
Number of months the customer has stayed with the provider (0 to 72)
Whether the customer has phone service ('Yes', 'No')
Whether the customer has multiple phone lines ('Yes', 'No', 'No phone service')
Customer internet service tier ('DSL', 'Fiber optic', 'No')
Online security add-on subscription ('Yes', 'No', 'No internet service')
Online backup add-on subscription ('Yes', 'No', 'No internet service')
Device protection add-on subscription ('Yes', 'No', 'No internet service')
Dedicated technical support add-on ('Yes', 'No', 'No internet service')
Streaming TV add-on subscription ('Yes', 'No', 'No internet service')
Streaming movies add-on subscription ('Yes', 'No', 'No internet service')
Contract term ('Month-to-month', 'One year', 'Two year')
Whether paperless billing is active ('Yes', 'No')
Billing payment method ('Electronic check', 'Mailed check', 'Bank transfer (automatic)', 'Credit card (automatic)')
Current monthly recurring charge in USD
Cumulative total charges billed to the customer in USD (imputed 0.0 for tenure=0)
Target variable indicating whether customer cancelled service ('Yes', 'No')
Audit flag: 1 if raw TotalCharges was blank (tenure=0), 0 otherwise
Numeric binary churn indicator (1 = Churned, 0 = Retained)
Human-readable Senior Citizen status ('Yes', 'No') for Power BI/reporting
Tenure cohort band ('0-12 Months', '13-24 Months', '25-48 Months', '49-72 Months')
Lifecycle and contract segment ('New Month-to-Month (<=12m)', 'Established Month-to-Month (>12m)', 'One-Year Contract', 'Two-Year Contract')
Count of active internet add-on services (0 to 6)
Binary flag: 1 if payment method is automatic bank transfer or credit card, 0 otherwise
Binary flag: 1 if customer has a Partner or Dependents, 0 otherwise
